status: Fixed in source — frozen runner publication pending
finding: The root-drop builder writes atm.runnerSourceSeal.v1 to release/atm-root-drop/release-manifest.json and calculates its digest from clean Git blob identifiers, while the frozen CLI checks a nonexistent repository-root release-manifest.json and recalculates direct source bytes. A freshly built runner can therefore report source drift even when its sealed source is unchanged.
expectedBehavior: A frozen runner must discover the durable root-drop manifest and validate a source seal using exactly the same byte-level digest contract used by the builder. An unchanged seal clears the drift warning; missing, malformed, or byte-mismatched seals remain fail-closed.
evidenceOrRepro: Before the repair, node atm.mjs --version reported sourceSeal.present=false even though release/atm-root-drop/release-manifest.json contained atm.runnerSourceSeal.v1. The recorded seal used Git blob identifiers while the verifier used source bytes, proving a second deterministic mismatch. The focused root-drop fixture now commits the inputs, builds a seal, writes the release manifest at its production path, and proves inspectRunnerSourceDrift reports the seal present and valid.
containment: The repair only aligns existing source-seal location and hashing semantics. It does not weaken the missing/malformed/mismatch failure path, bypass runner-sync stewardship, or alter taskflow close authority.
followUp: Run one governed frozen-runner publication after this source repair and then verify node atm.mjs --version no longer emits ATM_RUNNER_SOURCE_DRIFT. Resolve the pre-existing runner-sync queue receipt separately if its requested-surface contract still prevents release.
